role_place: Bishop of Hippo Regius (North Africa) from 395/396; main anti-Donatist polemicist and theologian of the Latin West.
why_relevant: The one Father who both pleads against executing Donatists and defends imperial fines and exile for them; he also approves the death penalty for pagan sacrifice (idolatry) in Letter 93.10.
